rationale: Verb of the Watchers' descent and transgression. Possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲡⲱⲃⲥ̄/ⲡⲱⲃϣ̄ with sense 'fall short, transgress, defile.' Used here for the moment the Egregoroi violated cosmic order before descending to earth — the standard Manichaean Watchers motif drawing on 1 Enoch and the Book of Giants.

Opaque lexeme designating the cosmic location where the Watchers established their prison; modified by 'of the land of the lower side.' Possible compound with 3sg.m suffix -ϥ̄. Confidence low; flag for parallels.
Numeral form of the Watcher-cities. Possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲙⲏⲧⲥⲛⲟⲟⲩⲥⲉ '12'; alternative readings 'thirty-X' (ⲙⲁⲃ '30' + units) cannot be excluded. Confidence low.

Cosmological term, paired with ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲣⲱϥ̄ 'the watcher who is outside.' Both likely derive from the ⲟⲩⲣⲏϩ/ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲱϥ 'watch, vigil' family. In context, the Third Ambassador is sent to these watch-stations to purify the light and separate night and day — likely cosmic luminaries (sun/moon) or related guardian stations.
Companion term to ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲣⲏⲍ; modified by ⲉⲧⲍⲓⲃⲁⲗ 'who is outside.' Cosmic guardian station; technical Manichaean term.
Verb governing 'the radiant from the destroyed, from one another.' Possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ 'raise/distinguish' or a separation-verb. Eschatological-cosmological function. Confidence low.

Plural qualitative substantive, tentatively from a Coptic ⲡⲣⲓⲉ/ⲡⲓⲣⲉ-stem 'shine' (cf. ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ 'the Radiance' in glossary). Antithetical pair-partner with ⲛⲉⲧⲧⲁⲭⲁⲓ̈ⲧ 'the destroyed ones' in eschatological separation context.
Plural qualitative on ⲧⲁⲕⲟ 'destroy' = 'those-having-been-destroyed.' Stands antithetically against ⲛⲉⲧⲃⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲧ in the cosmological-eschatological separation pattern of this kephalaion.

Verb in 'before Sin ⲁⲱⲉⲓ̈ⲧⲉ and reigned in the flesh.' Possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲁϣⲁⲓ̈ 'be many, multiply' or ⲁⲩⲝⲁⲛⲉ 'grow.' Context: Sin's growth/expansion in the flesh as cosmic event preceding the Judge's mission.
Lyc. ⲡⲱⲣⲭ + 3pl object suffix -ⲟⲩ (= Sah. ⲡⲱⲣϫ-ⲥⲉ 'separate them'). Already in glossary as ⲡⲱⲣⲭ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; this entry documents the suffixed form.

Verb governing the pre-emanation of the Christ. Possibly Lyc. reflex of ⲧⲱϣ 'appoint, fix' or ⲧⲱⲣⲉ 'establish.' Used in parallel with ⲁⲩⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ 'they called forth' (line 14) and ⲁⲩⲧⲛⲛⲁⲩϥ 'they sent him' as cosmogonic/pre-cosmic verbs of divine commissioning.
Preposition ⲟⲩⲃⲉ- 'against, opposite' with 3pl suffix -ⲩ. Antagonist-marker in the cosmic-pre-emanation context: Christ is brought forth against the future Error and false doctrines.

Verb of cutting; here transitively against Error. Cf. accumulated ⲟⲩⲱⲥϩ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'cut away from / reap out from.' This form ⲟⲩⲱⲥϥ has -ϥ ending (cf. Sah. ⲟⲩⲱϣϥ 'shatter') — possibly a related but distinct lexeme meaning 'destroy, smash.'
